newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Xpedite Systems rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Xpedite Systems rated buy.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc initiated coverage on Xpedite Systems Inc, rating the company a buy.
-- Rodman cited the company's strong earnings growth potential and dominance in a niche market.
-- Xpedite, which provides broadcast messaging services via fax or E-mail, is currently priced 1.3 times Rodman's earnings per share estimate for fiscal 1997, said Rodman.
-- The company's 12-18-month price target is $30, 20 times Rodman's earnings-per-share estimate for 1997, said Rodman.
